subject: Biology
source_note: TIE (2023), Biology Syllabus for Ordinary Secondary Education Form I-IV

topics.title: Demonstrate mastery of the concepts, principles and processes of Biology

sub_topics.title: Describe the physiological, anatomical and ecological processes of living organisms
competences: (a) Describe nutrition in human and ruminants (nutrients, digestive system and processes)
(b) Describe the mechanism of transportation of materials in flowering plants (vascular system, absorption and movement of water and mineral salts and transpiration)
(c) Describe the mechanism of transportation of materials in the human body (the mammalian heart, blood vessels, blood, blood circulation)
(d) Describe the mechanisms of gaseous exchange and respiration in mammals (gaseous exchange in mammals, aerobic and anaerobic respiration)
(e) Describe the mechanism of gaseous exchange in plants (parts of plants responsible for gaseous exchange and the process)

objectives.text: (a) Describe nutrition in human and ruminants (nutrients, digestive system and processes)
objectives.teaching_methods: Brainstorming, Jigsaw, ICT-Based learning, Group discussion, disorders of human digestive system
objectives.resources: Variety of food substances, charts/ pictures displaying variety of food nutrients, models/charts of human and ruminant digestive system, dissected mammal specimen displaying digestive system, charts/ photographs showing common disorders and diseases of human digestive system
objectives.assessment_criteria: Nutrition in human and ruminants is described clearly

objectives.text: (b) Describe the mechanism of transportation of materials in flowering plants (vascular system, absorption and movement of water and mineral salts and transpiration)
objectives.teaching_methods: Brainstorming, Group discussion, ICT based learning, Question and answers
objectives.resources: Charts/model/ photographs showing transportation of materials in plants, relevant equipment and apparati, stain, potted plants, germinated seeds, and transportation of materials in plants online resources
objectives.assessment_criteria: Mechanism of transportation of materials in flowering plants is described clearly

objectives.text: (c) Describe the mechanism of transportation of materials in the human body (the mammalian heart, blood vessels, blood, blood circulation)
objectives.teaching_methods: Brainstorming, Field trip, ICT-Based learning, Group discussion
objectives.resources: Mammalian heart models/ charts/ photographs, blood circulatory system online resources, dissected mammal displaying the heart and major blood vessels and charts showing diseases and disorders of human circulatory system
objectives.assessment_criteria: The mechanism of transportation of materials in the human body are described clearly

objectives.text: (d) Describe the mechanisms of gaseous exchange and respiration in mammals (gaseous exchange in mammals, aerobic and anaerobic respiration)
objectives.teaching_methods: Brainstorm, ICT-based learning, Group discussion, Guest speaker, Exploration
objectives.resources: Models/ photographs/ charts showing structure of the lungs and alveolus in human, online resources on gaseous exchange and respiration in mammals
objectives.assessment_criteria: The mechanisms of gaseous exchange and respiration in mammals are described clearly

objectives.text: (e) Describe the mechanism of gaseous exchange in plants (parts of plants responsible for gaseous exchange and the process)
objectives.teaching_methods: Questions and answers, ICT based learning
objectives.resources: Plant leaves, photographs showing the structure of stomata, potted plants, charts/pictures of gaseous exchange in plants, and gaseous exchange in plants online resources
objectives.assessment_criteria: The mechanism of gaseous exchange in plants is described clearly

sub_topics.title: Demonstrate mastery of basic skills for conducting biological investigations
competences: (a) Investigate food nutrients in various food samples
(b) Investigate processes of transportation of materials in flowering plants
(c) Carry out experiments to determine the pulse rate in human
(d) Investigate aerobic and anaerobic respiration in living organisms

objectives.text: (a) Investigate food nutrients in various food samples
objectives.resources: Relevant reagents and chemicals, various food samples, apparati and source of heat
objectives.assessment_criteria: Food nutrients in various food samples are investigated correctly using the scientific procedures

objectives.text: (b) Investigate processes of transportation of materials in flowering plants
objectives.resources: Diagram/ video showing transverse section of living plant tissues, mounted slides of plant tissues, relevant reagents and chemicals, source of heat, plants with variegated leaves, distilled water, ringed plant, charts/ video showing transportation of materials in plants, and online resources on transportation of materials in plants
objectives.assessment_criteria: Processes of transportation of materials in flowering plants are investigated correctly

objectives.text: (c) Carry out experiments to determine the pulse rate in human
objectives.resources: Blood pressure machine, smartphone app, digital fitness trackers and exercise machine
objectives.assessment_criteria: Experiments to determine the pulse rate in human are carried out correctly

objectives.text: (d) Investigate aerobic and anaerobic respiration in living organisms
objectives.resources: Charts/ diagrams on aerobic and anaerobic respiration of living organisms
objectives.assessment_criteria: Aerobic and anaerobic respiration in living organisms are investigated correctly

sub_topics.title: Prepare and present results of biological investigations
competences: (a) Prepare and present a report of a biological investigation on ( food nutrients in various food samples, transportation of materials in flowering plants, pulse rate in human, aerobic and anaerobic respiration )

objectives.text: (a) Prepare and present a report of a biological investigation on ( food nutrients in various food samples, transportation of materials in flowering plants, pulse rate in human, aerobic and anaerobic respiration )
objectives.resources: Steps / procedures for biological investigations online resources
objectives.assessment_criteria: A biological investigation report is prepared and presented correctly using scientific procedures
